generated_from: curated playable payoff dispatch overlay; edit with backlog dispatch validation
selection_rule: Choose the highest-ranked milestone with an actionable referenced backlog item unless ledger gates, stale dispatch metadata, dirty worktree stabilization, or a source/fidelity conflict requires another slice. This map changes priority only; it never promotes scaffolded behavior to EV Classic fidelity without a promotion packet.

milestones.player_payoff: A player can launch, navigate to objectives, manage fuel/range feedback, hyperspace, land, and recover from common travel blockers.
milestones.required_playable_capability: End-to-end travel loop: route selection, fuel/range affordance, jump, land, and recovery when jump/landing is blocked.
milestones.acceptable_scaffold_boundary: TV-side route and recovery affordances may be scaffolded when labeled; exact Classic topology, timing, and port approach behavior remain gated by decoded-resource or original-runtime evidence.
milestones.promotion_gate: Decoded topology/link/coordinate promotion plus original-runtime evidence for UI/timing-sensitive travel transitions before any fidelity-promoted travel claim.
milestones.notes: Priority 1 because broad TV playability depends on moving between systems safely; static topology slices are selected when they unblock this loop.

milestones.player_payoff: A player can accept a mission, reserve cargo/deadline context, carry profitable spare cargo, deliver, sell, refuel, and understand next objectives.
milestones.required_playable_capability: Mission/trade hybrid loop: mission discovery, acceptance, route/objective tracking, cargo reservation, destination delivery, retained-cargo sale, and recovery guidance.
milestones.acceptable_scaffold_boundary: Strategy/economy helpers may stay TV scaffold while exact EV Classic mission generation, commodity spread formulas, and UI wording remain needs-evidence or promotion-gated.
milestones.promotion_gate: Original-runtime or decoded/manual-backed mission/economy packets must identify exact claim, evidence, verifier, uncertainty, and backlog update before fidelity promotion.
milestones.notes: Priority 2 because travel becomes meaningful when tied to missions, cargo, fuel, deadlines, and credits.

milestones.player_payoff: A player can land and use visible services consistently: bar, mission computer, commodity exchange, outfitter, shipyard, repairs, gambling or absent-service recovery where applicable.
milestones.required_playable_capability: Service matrix loop: landed panels expose only available services, blocked services explain recovery, and service actions mutate player state only when valid.
milestones.acceptable_scaffold_boundary: Current TV service matrices and guardrails can remain scaffolded by system; Classic-wide service/store claims require decoded resource/static promotion or original-runtime spot checks.
milestones.promotion_gate: Promote decoded service/store resource fields and use Basilisk only for ambiguous UI-sensitive surfaces before fidelity-promoted service claims.
milestones.notes: Priority 3 because landed services are the hub connecting travel, missions, economy, upgrades, and recovery.

milestones.player_payoff: A player can plan, afford, buy, verify, save/resume, and recover from ship/outfit/capacity/fuel/repair upgrades.
milestones.required_playable_capability: Upgrade/ship loop: identify service availability, compare purchase goals, enforce credit/cargo/state guardrails, mutate inventory/ship, and verify Player Info/save-resume visibility.
milestones.acceptable_scaffold_boundary: Upgrade planning, affordability, and recovery guidance may stay TV scaffold; exact Classic starting inventory, shipyard/outfitter stock, stat formulas, and pricing need source-backed promotion.
milestones.promotion_gate: Non-mutating Classic Player Info/outfitter/shipyard evidence or decoded ship/outfit/resource manifests must back exact inventory/stat/stock claims.
milestones.notes: Priority 4 because upgrades convert mission/trade progress into durable player capability.

milestones.player_payoff: A player can survive or intentionally engage threats with labeled targeting, weapon, damage, repair, legal/reputation, and escape affordances.
milestones.required_playable_capability: Combat/survival loop: targeting, firing, taking/avoiding damage, afterburner/escape, repair recovery, and legal/AI consequences labeled by evidence state.
milestones.acceptable_scaffold_boundary: Survival affordances and deterministic TV combat probes may be scaffolded; exact cadence, timing, physics feel, target selection, and damage values remain original-runtime/timing evidence gated.
milestones.promotion_gate: Basilisk/original-runtime timing and combat observations, including 1x sentinel where timing-sensitive, plus decoded/manual support where applicable before fidelity promotion.
preferred_verifier_family: Basilisk timing lane only when safe and explicitly needed
milestones.notes: Priority 5 because it is essential to full EV play but has the highest timing/destructive-evidence risk; keep disposable-pilot and Strict-Play gates explicit.

milestones.player_payoff: Broad scaffolded loops are steadily converted into source-backed EV Classic fidelity without stale labels or unsupported claims.
milestones.required_playable_capability: Promotion loop: identify scaffolded/high-uncertainty claims, gather the strongest allowed evidence, update manifests/probes/backlog labels, and demote stale claims on conflict.
milestones.acceptable_scaffold_boundary: Promotion work may be prioritized after playable gaps unless a source/fidelity conflict, stale claim, or gate requires immediate correction.
milestones.promotion_gate: Each fidelity-promoted claim must satisfy tv-spec promotion packet requirements: exact claim, oracle class, source basis, evidence paths, verifier result, uncertainty, owner, and backlog/provenance update.
preferred_verifier_family: focused extractor/model/runtime verifier for the promoted claim
milestones.notes: Priority 6 is not low quality; it means promotion normally follows broad playable coverage unless correctness, conflict, or safety requires immediate promotion/demotion work.
